questions.question: Aw, Bt, Ck, Dv, Er, Fn and Gy are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Bt sits second to the right of Aw. Ck sits third to the left of Aw. Er sits to the immediate right of Gy. Dv sits second to the right of Er. What is the position of Fe with respect to Er?
questions.solution:
1. Since all persons face the centre: right = counterclockwise, left = clockwise. Fix **Aw** at pos(1). **Bt** sits second to the right of **Aw** (counterclockwise): **Aw**(1) → pos(2) → **Bt**(3).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/465f24fe4927fc1928e6927f1ef24adcad6d2bd6d5f4cf0bb2eae22b2251d028.png] 
2. **Ck** sits third to the left of **Aw** (clockwise): **Aw**(1) → pos(7) → pos(6) → **Ck**(5).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4744a6c1b1c39f8b2a38e032b2dc223fc6cb48cf5a97b68cee2f42ca007eed01.png] 
3. **Er** sits to the immediate right of **Gy** (counterclockwise). **Dv** sits second to the right of **Er**. The only available adjacent slots fitting this chain **Gy** → **Er** → skip → **Dv** are pos(6), pos(7), and pos(2). So, **Gy**(6), **Er**(7), and **Dv**(2).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50c5e2c8bdd94ba1c2252a8c92fa5fbc37a5397777a3d8c983ba7f198c22d30d.png] 
4. The only remaining person **Fn** (**Fe**) occupies the last vacant position, pos(4). Final: **Aw**(1), **Dv**(2), **Bt**(3), **Fn**(4), **Ck**(5), **Gy**(6), **Er**(7).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa97e4fa622bb7a2c0f3d11ac57910f98b52f86cec23df4df813f9153b28e3cf.png] 
**
To find the position of **Fe** (**Fn**) with respect to **Er**, we count from **Er** at pos(7) to **Fn** at pos(4). Moving clockwise (left): **Er**(7) → **Gy**(6) → **Ck**(5) → **Fn**(4). This is third to the left**.

**
Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 4'**.

71 S 45 P 5 R 15 Q 5 P 6 S 13 R 74 S 69 = ?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f08474400e5bdcbf0727a78f8fb4d425ac2664f4d1008c5b517a63ae509fb9f4.png]

71 S 45 P 5 R 15 Q 5 P 6 S 13 R 74 S 69 = ?

After replacing the letters with their respective signs, we get:

= 71 + 45 × 5 − __**15 ÷ 5**__ × 6 + 13 − 74 + 69

= 71 + __**45 × 5**__ − __**3 × 6**__ + 13 − 74 + 69

= 71 + 225 - 18 + 13 - 74 + 69

= __**378 - 92**__

= **286**

Therefore, the value that will come in place of the question mark is 286.

questions.question: Six friends B, C, L, M, N and O are sitting around a circular table facing the center of the table. Only three people sit between B and M when counted from the right of B. B sits second to the left of O. L sits second to the left of C. N is an immediate neighbor of both M and O. How many people sit between B and N when counted from the right of B?
questions.solution:
1. Six friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. **Right** direction is **counterclockwise** and **Left** direction is **clockwise**. Fix **B** at position (1). Only three people sit between **B** and **M** from the right of **B**: **B(1)** → pos(2) → pos(3) → pos(4) → **M(5)**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e78700eee2ad9a6a073fde4bd9be8c795c8ef91ec661be9d3283d910702593a3.png] 
2. **B** sits second to the left of **O**. **Left** of **O** is **clockwise**. So **O** must be at position (3): **O(3)** → pos(2) → **B(1)**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75c401b4db9e165d104b13b5ba95fcb9b20f66e5f7faed0f3d327f697a04513a.png] 
3. **N** is an immediate neighbor of both **M** and **O**. Since **O** is at (3) and **M** is at (5), **N** must be at position (4).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fa0b267f5ccad6fc20354c2fe2389169a00a0d11e39567c3cb78a36c657d3a1.png] 
4. **L** sits second to the left of **C**. **Left** is **clockwise**. Remaining positions are (2) and (6). If **C** is at (2), then **clockwise**: **C(2)** → pos(1) → **L(6)**. This fits the arrangement.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff4ca7d9c4af9f4a5527fda76e95ff76769cec12262137ef7b89a2e6a452176f.png] 

To find how many people sit between **B** and **N** when counted from the **right** of **B** (counterclockwise from **B**): **B(1)** → **C(2)** → **O(3)** → **N(4)**. There are **two** people (**C** and **O**) between them.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**.

questions.question: Mr. Kell ranked 155th from the bottom and 37th from the top in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Rank of **Mr. Kell** from the **top** = 37th

Rank of **Mr. Kell** from the **bottom** = 155th

To find the **total number of students** in the class, the following formula is used:

**Total number of students** = (Position from the top + Position from the bottom) − 1

= (37 + 155) − 1

= 192 − 1

= 191

So, there are **191 students** in the class.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**.
